briefing.headline: Harbour lead 2-0 at the break and closed out a 3-0 win with stronger second-half final-third activity

first_half.text: Kestrel edged possession and were more active in the final third in the first half, reflected by higher possession_wmean (50.9% vs 49.1%) and higher final-third entries_wmean (3.56 vs 2.33 per five minutes).
Despite Kestrel's territorial numbers, Harbour scored twice in the first half (2 goals) while maintaining lower overall possession in that period.

changes.text: Kestrel's pressing intensity eased in the second half: their PPDA_wmean rose from 4.9 to 5.9 (a 20% increase), indicating reduced pressure.

Harbour's channel entries per-window rose across centre/left/right after the break (centre 1.11→1.22, left 0.67→1.00, right 0.56→0.89), while Kestrel shifted more activity to the right channel entries (1.33→2.00 per_window).

predictions.text: Kestrel will crowd Harbour's centre so Harbour's centre channel entries decrease by at least 30%.
Kestrel's PPDA will increase by at least 20% as their press is maintained into the second half.
Kestrel will increase their final-third entries by at least 20% as they chase the game.
Harbour will increase their final-third entries by at least 20%.
Harbour will increase their progressive passes by at least 15% to move the ball more directly.
Harbour will decrease Kestrel's high regains by at least 10% by adjusting to Kestrel's high press.

result.text: Harbour finished with three goals total (2 in the first half, 1 in the second), while increasing their second-half final-third entries and possession level relative to the first half.

Kestrel generated similar high-regain activity across both halves (high_regains_wmean 1.33 → 1.33 per five minutes) and saw a drop in xG from 1.44 to 1.01 and a small rise in shots from 8 to 9, but recorded no goals.

The statistical story shows Harbour raised their final-third presence and overall possession after the break while Kestrel's measured pressing loosened; the match ended 3-0 to Harbour with those shifts visible in the provided channel-entry, possession and PPDA metrics, though the data here describe association rather than proving direct causation of each goal.

removed_claims: changes: Harbour increased final-third activity after the break: final_third_entries_wmean rose from 2.33 to 3.11 per five minutes (a 34% increase), and their overall possession_wmean rose from 49.1% to 51.9%.
